secondary-bg.$description: Component token — Button / secondary: filled neutral.

ghost-hover.$description: Component token — Button / ghost and icon hover fill.

bg.$description: Component token — TextField and Select fill.

border.$description: Component token — TextField outline at rest.

border-invalid.$description: Component token — TextField outline when invalid; always with a message.

row-changed-mark.$description: Component token — AssetRow 'recently changed' leading mark (with text 'Changed').

bar-bg.$description: Component token — ContextBar fill inside a product workspace.

scrim.$description: Component token — Backdrop behind dialogs and the command menu.

letterbox.$description: Component token — StoryboardFrame matte around artwork.

track-off.$description: Component token — Switch track when off — reuses the control-edge colour so the off state meets 3:1.

track-on.$description: Component token — Switch track when on.

thumb.$description: Component token — Switch knob in both states and themes.

plate.$description: Component token — Plate behind black product lockups on dark surfaces.
